newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Q3 foreign loan approvals $1.817 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Q3 foreign loan approvals $1.817 bln.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it approved more foreign loans in the third quarter amounting to $1.817 billion compared with $1.071 billion in the second quarter.
This brings its total foreign loan approvals to to $3.622 billion in the first three quarters, it said.
The national government accounted for 81.6 percent of the loans approved in the third quarter.
The bulk of the loans approved in the third quarter were to be used for infrastructure and power transmission projects, the Central Bank said.
According to currency, 62.6 percent of the loans were in yen; 32.3 percent in U.S. dollars; and the balance of 5.1 percent in various currencies.
